_note: Residency-log audit of the two claims this work depends on: whether the believed tier is ever HOST, and whether telemetry_cached_tokens is ever positive. OBSERVED from committed residency logs; nothing here is measured on an engine by this session.
_register: OBSERVED COUNT over committed logs, not a constructed bound and not a census of any single cell

claim_host_never.verdict: CONFIRMED on a wider base than the 39 cells it was reported from: host appears in 0 of 20630 rows across 213 residency logs. The branch exists in code (cstate.py:169, reachable at :447 and :486) and no committed run reaches the state, so reload-from-host has no observed trigger state and must not be scored as a mechanism that failed.

claim_telemetry_never_positive.verdict: DISAGREEMENT RESOLVED, not a contradiction. It was reported positive in NONE of 18,738 rows across 45 cells; over 213 logs it is positive in 95 rows. The two populations differ: every positive row is in a PILOT or acceptance run (pilot/runs3, pilot/runs4, accept_d114, harness_addendum), and zero are in the frozen-grid and sweep cells that sweep covered. Both readings are correct on their own population.
claim_telemetry_never_positive.mechanism: 72 of 95 positive rows are on the PIECE-CHAINING arms (edf-piece1024, edf-piece2048), and 72 of 95 positive rows carry believed_tier = 'cold'. That is exactly the gap coordinator.py:745-752 documents: in a piece chain the already-built prefix IS reused on the wire as uuid references, so piece k+1 reports cached_tokens > 0 while the readiness the arm sees still says COLD. The telemetry is not dead; it is only ever exercised by an arm that slices.
claim_telemetry_never_positive._label_fix: the first pass of this audit reported an arm literally named 'run', 6 rows: a path-parsing artifact of the .../<cell>/run/residency.jsonl layout used by the acceptance runs. Corrected here to the owning arm. The totals and every verdict are unchanged.

consequence_for_warm_all: WARM-ALL must slice, and it does: WARM_AHEAD_SLICE_TOKENS = 1024, so every warm-ahead prefill is submitted with slice_tokens set and takes the coordinator's kind='piece' path (observed: 77 release_piece rows in the shimmed smoke cell where b7 emits none). A monolithic warm-ahead would have produced the same warm state while leaving the belief corrector with nothing to read. This is the one place where the choice of a default is load-bearing rather than cosmetic.
